      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "et $F$ un module quasi-cohérent sur $Y$",
      "note": "For the Čech cohomology of the covering X → Y, the coefficient module must be on Y. The TeX keeps the printed X."

      "where": "Reference following (*)",
      "scan": "cf. réf [4] de IX",
      "tex": "\\cf ref [4] de\nIX",

      "confidence": "high",

      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\mathfrak{X} = (X_i)_{i \\in I}",

    {

      "scan": "où 𝒜_i est une Algèbre quasi-cohérente sur X_i",

      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Ff_{\\mathfrak{X}} /\\Cat I",
      "note": "The indexing fibred category is F_𝔛 over Cat I, not the fibre F_X. The TeX keeps the ordinary X printed in this subscript."

      "fix": {
        "old": "par. Il",
        "new": "par. 11"

    {
